summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K furnishing a shareholder letter regarding its Integrated Annual Report and notice of the 42nd Annual General Meeting to be held July 23, 2026 via videoconference. The filing also announces a final dividend of 8 per equity share with a record date of July 10, 2026 and payment on or before July 30, 2026. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is described. This is a routine reporting of an annual meeting notice and dividend declaration, not a special situation that triggers a distinct corporate event.
